results.condition: data: the carrot and kiwi cost an ordinary-seed amount > 0 (tuning value), footprint 2
with 20 seeds the carrot may be fired
after firing, the cost is held back (available -cost) but seeds are not yet spent
the cost is spent exactly once when the plant is placed, nothing stays reserved
a landing on bad ground spends nothing and releases the held-back cost
a shot that vanishes in the air gives the held-back cost back
cancelling with nothing in flight does not refund extra or go negative
with fewer seeds than the cost the plant cannot be fired
two shots in flight need two costs: with 2*cost-1 seeds the second cannot be fired
with max_count=2: fire 1 ok, fire 2 ok, fire 3 refused while 2 are in flight (nothing planted yet)
the carrot limit does not block the kiwi
after both land, count 2 reaches the limit: still refused; planted count never exceeds 2
even if a third shot was fired, landing cannot exceed the kind limit, and it costs nothing
can_fire_seed (ordinary seeds) respects held-back seeds too: 5 seeds, kiwi in flight costs 3 -> 2 available
the three kinds are normal (footprint 1), carrot, kiwi (footprint 2) in that order
